blind.description: A stylized wooden hide-drying or tanning rack. It consists of a rectangular timber frame bound at the corners with dark reddish-brown leather straps, supported in an A-frame fashion by two angled rear prop poles. An animal pelt with rich brown fur and pale cream edges is stretched across the center of the frame, fastened securely to all four sides with leather loops/ties. Textures are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted wood grain and fur details.
blind.from_above: Seen from straight above, it appears as a horizontal wooden beam with rounded end-caps lashed at the corners, showing leather loop ties attaching the upper rim of the hide, two angled support legs protruding forward/downward, and casting a distinct lattice-like shadow behind it.
blind.height_vs_figure: About two-thirds as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3.5 to 4 feet tall) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.

notes: footprint proportion 1.89x off the catalog (5.5 x 4.2 ft)
